name: deploy-nxtphase-demo
description: Deploy any app to the team's Railway workspace and put it on a <name>.demo.nxtphase.ai domain, as an invokable skill. Explores the codebase, creates the Railway project and service, wires DNS through Cloudflare, deploys, and verifies. Ships no credentials: the skill reads RAILWAY_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_TOKEN from a .env file that the user creates, and tells them which colleague to ask for the values.
